item.title: Master Salary Talks with Confidence 💰 • Research average salaries for your role. • List your unique skills and achievements. • Practice aloud to sound natural and confident. • Use: “I am seeking a salary of X based on my experience.” • Prepare to discuss benefits, not just salary. How can you tailor your negotiation approach to the company's culture? #salary #negotiation #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
